environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at nginx. No application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs as a systemd service with gunicorn. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db contains production user records including admin credentials and PII.
